responsibility: Provides the C-family frontend integration for S/390-specific language features and intrinsics. It owns parsing support for vector/bool target keywords and conditional macro expansion, builds and consults the overloaded builtin type/signature tables generated from s390-builtins.def and s390-builtin-types.def, resolves S/390 intrinsic overloads with target-feature and immediate-operand checking, issues frontend diagnostics for invalid builtin usage, and registers target pragma and overloaded-builtin hooks used by the C front end.
